claude: Praised for strong coding, writing and analysis; many find usage limits run out quickly on cheaper plans.
enpass: Liked for keeping data in a private cloud or locally; some find bugs and a sense development has stalled.
gemini: Praised for accuracy, speed and strong research tools; several report confident wrong answers.
keepassxc: Liked as a reliable, local, private manager with no subscription; some find manual syncing painful.
keeper: Valued as easy to use and well suited to teams; many find bugs, a high price and upsells.
mullvad-vpn: Praised as simple, reliable and fast with a flat price; several left after port forwarding was dropped.
nordpass: Liked as easy to use and reliable with a clean look; many find bugs and slowness.
proton-pass: Liked for a clean interface, email aliases and a usable free plan; some miss features like folders.
windscribe: Liked as good value with useful extras like split tunnelling; some find the free plan data cap limiting.
